title: The file says its own number may be wrong, and the number was quoted anyway
detects: A result artefact carrying a `budget_warning`: the producing tool recorded, at the moment it wrote the file, that the generation budget was below the point where a refusal rate stops describing the budget and starts describing the model. A reply that would have refused at token 200 is scored as compliant if the budget stopped at 32, so the rate reads low for a reason that has nothing to do with the model.
incident: Ours, 2026-09-17. A hostile reviewer fed this checker an artefact whose own `budget_warning` field held the exact sentence the scorer emits about being below the visibility floor, and the report said `nothing found`. The adapter was not even carrying the field into the normalised document, so no check could have read it however many existed. Behind it, ours, 2026-09-12: the 48 token budget warning fired on every arm of a published head to head and the question of whether the refusal axis was a budget artefact was live enough to threaten withdrawing the numbers. The warning had also been written down twice, in 2026-07-21 and 2026-07-29, and read by nobody both times.
remedy: Re-score at or above the visibility floor and compare. If the rate moves, the original figure was about the budget. If it does not, you have a measurement and a reason to believe it. Do not quote the figure comparatively until then: a short budget flatters whichever model answers at greater length, so it tilts a comparison rather than adding noise to it.
false_positive: A length sweep sets short budgets deliberately, and every one of its points will carry this warning and fire this check. That is correct rather than a false positive: the finding is that the number cannot be read as a refusal rate, which is exactly true of a sweep point, and a sweep is quoted as a curve rather than as a rate. The check reads a field only this project's scorer writes, so an artefact from another harness that had the same problem would not fire it. That is a coverage gap, not a clean bill of health. An artefact that records nothing under this field is SKIPPED rather than passed, because the adapter writes the normalised field whether or not the producer put anything in it, and a check that counted those as examined would report every artefact in this project clean on a question it never asked.

fires_on.budget_warning: gen-tokens 32 is below the 96 visibility floor
the budget was 48 and refusal markers sit at a median of character 306
